about: Every triaged oracle difference (chapter 28.10), by signature: a nightly run fails only on a signature not here, and each ends as a fixture.

records.reference: spareware PR #878 (fix/G154-export-fold c3b02f41: the export's triangles cover what a face's rounded outline encloses) and join/oracles-live 56e2e078 (the comparison measures the kernel's exact result)
records.why: Ours: the comparison measured the kernel's result through the export's triangles, whose rounded outline of face x = 8 folded back along itself, so they left part of the face bare (1.022 steps from Manifold's right answer); the exact volume was the reference's. Oracle run 43548473272, job 1763.

records.reference: join/oracles-live 56e2e078 (the comparison measures the kernel's exact result, not the export's triangles)
records.why: Ours: the comparison measured the kernel's result through the export's triangles, which rightly refuse face 0 because its rounded sides cross, so the job went unmeasured; the exact volume was the reference's and Manifold's answer agrees with the exact faces. Oracle run 43548473272, job 1891.
